title: Optus: $300 Cashback for 5G Home Internet, $250 Cashback for NBN Home Internet (New Optus Customers) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Optus: $300 Cashback for 5G Home Internet, $250 Cashback for NBN Home Internet (New Optus Customers) @ TopCashback AU

[cook99] Hmm which is less likely to fail tracking, Finder or TCB?
[Tanvry] TCB has about a 90% tracking rate for me for numerous orders, very unreliable for sites like Temu woolworths pizza hut and david jones, Finder only used it once and it's tracked that one time
[sunnymel] The other day they had Klook 25% cashback on. $50 order tracked fine. $1200 dollar hotel booking failed. The only difference was the $50 dollar booking was done using in-app browser. For the hotel booking it jumped from in-app browser to Klook app which didn’t track. The case is opened, hopefully it will be approved.
[Tanvry] Klook has always tracked for me if you use the pay now option using a desktop browser (edge) and don't have adblock etc those extensions
[test8888] looks CB is a little better. Finder's VISA card is now hard to add on apple wallet, most of my iPhones are flagged.
[StingyMan] Second this, wasn't able to add the card to Apple wallet. Looking at the appstore reviews the Blackstone network app seems to have been like this for a couple of months. Only way to use is via manually entering card number for online payments
[Aesir5] Same as I found with a recent ecconex gift card via Blackhawk. I can’t add it to iPhone wallet, no option presents itself.
[tunzafun001] Couldn't use finder giftcard to pay council rates (manually entered)..
[StingyMan] @tunzafun001: I do hope the card itself does work, because I actually haven't tried entering it anywhere yet. Just saw the card number + pin and assumed it would work.
[jezza p] @tunzafun001: Can’t use that Visa card to buy other gift card online either. I got a couple from previous deals. It’s a pain in the back side to use. I just ended up dumping it all on my Amazon account and called it a day. Much prefer cashback that can be withdrawn
[mooodeng] Easy to withdraw using PayPal but against their t&c's so won't share how
[Nobargainhere] Finder has a very low success rate based on comments on their deals.
[lostinsydney] Shopback wasn't great either. i never got $350!
I think, issue is Floptus
[Poison Ivy] I trusted Finder and regret it. So much time wasted and still no gift card. I should have trusted the negative reviews.
[Pacify] I'd say Finder.
I'm 5/5 for offers there, with a total of $1650 in giftcards
[sriver] Don't have issues with TCB and it's very easy to see if something has tracked or not. Finder can look like it's tracked and then just fail later on, I don't recommend finder to people.
[jsb] For me Finder never tracked for 2 deals that I did with them, had to email them with proofs and they later accepted them and I got the gift cards.
TCB has been more or less flawless for me. However, for this you have to stay connected for 120 days min. and if it doesn't track, you will prob. know in just a week and switch out
[Gotchas] How long do you have to be away from Optus to be considered a new customer ?
[bardddd] Be aware of the minimum cost for the 5G home plan.
The minimum total cost of this plan is $513 for new customers who cancel within 1 month (includes $468 modem cost and $40 promo offer credit).
Optus will cover the cost of the modem for each month you stay connected for 36 months on a device payment plan (i.e. you’ll be credited $13 per month over 36 months, so you'll pay $0 for the modem). If you leave within 36 months, you’ll pay the remaining modem in full (any credits or discounts will be forfeited). You won’t receive a pro-rata refund for the remainder of your payment cycle when you cancel. There are no other plan cancellation fees.
[lomie] Is there any way to sign up but BYO 5G modem? There are a few that pop up from time to time on fb marketplace. Just want to try it first before committing on changing permanently. Asking for an elderly resident in a retirement/lifestyle village where there is no choice of internet and it is slow and expensive.
[rrrrrrein] No, remember that it is Optus. It is a rip-off deal. If I recall correctly, it used to have a minimum spend of over $1,500 to $2,000.
[AircraftFreight] Can I put the 5G Home SIM Card into say a Netgear Nighthawk M7 Ultra for a portable broadband platform?
[RolePlayer88] currently already with optus nbn under my name. possible to cancel mine and use my wife name for new connection?
[Tiggrrrrr] I was going to do similar. But when I put my address in, it says "Sorry, 5G Home Internet isn't currently available at your address", despite already being on a 5G plan with an Optus supplied 5G Modem.
So I am assuming it associates the address with a service?
[TomGum] What’s the exit clause without penalty if the 5G speeds are crap? Does the minimum spend still apply?
[Funky-munky] Our experience with Optus 5G home broadband was abysmal. We would lose connection often, sometimes multiple times a day. Frustrating, as the speeds were great when it did work.
After countless disconnections, we called time and cancelled the contract.
(This occurred in both St Kilda East and Footscray)
[SaberXLancer] Any penalty if cancelled early?
I had the same situation with TPG but we can return the modern back to them when it is crap.
With Optus modern fee for 36 months it is so expensive when things not work as expected.
[Funky-munky] Nah. We had about 18 months or so left into the 36 months with regards to the modem.
They said we could keep it and it was not required to return it.
But, we had several cases noted on our account with connection issues, so that may have helped?
[SnowDragon] I'm with Optus for the S26U - I assume that means I have an active service?
[Tarun Tuli] Na it need to be mobile service is different than home internet
[Aykj] So for $69 500 Mbps plan: 6x$69 = $414 -$250 cashback = $164 / 6 = $27.33 for 6 months
Is this correct?
[happyangus] I guess less if you are able to ditch them after the posted minimum term and your CB tracks
[ElectricMallet] I signed up through the finder deal and it seems to have tracked. Optus process was a nightmare though. I couldn’t sign up online and had to ring the call centre, as my ID was linked to a separate account I’d used for the free 7 day network trial SIM card last year. Of course, I no longer had access to this number for the 2FA. Took around two hours all up - painful!
[sexy] Exactly same experience last week, finally decided to just give up and signed up Telstra with no cashback
[Dauphin3] The finder eligibility states: Maintain an active Optus service for at least 90 days post-activation
The TCB eligibility states: Internet & mobile postpaid plans must remain connected for a minimum of 120 days from sign-up date to be eligible for cashback.
So it appears you need to stay connected to Optus for an extra month to get the reward through TCB.
[Tanvry] With Finder it ended up being 5 months, signed up before and they had me stay for a few months extra to be eligible
[seanyong] "A new Optus customer is defined assomeone that has no active service with them."
Does this mean if I have Optus mobile plan, I will also be ineligible for the NBN plan CB?
[ElectricMallet] Not sure about TCB, but Finder has this helpful section in their t&cs for the similar $250 gift card deal:
Eligible customers include:
* Current or recent Optus NBN or 5G Home Internet customers (within 30 days) can apply for an eligible Mobile plan
* Current or recent Optus Mobile customers (within 30 days) can apply for an eligible NBN or 5G Home Internet plan
* Customers applying for the same type of product (NBN, 5G Home Internet or Mobile) must not have been a current or recent customer of that product type within the past 30 days
[seanyong] Thank you for sharing this! I will go with finder then.
[zmwang] I think just take the flybuy points one, much safer.
If I have to weight between Finder and TCB, I will go for TCB.
Both I have good experiences, and roughly around $300 ish money back from either site.
[donotuse] I've had the Finder before and didn't have a problem with tracking, the prepaid card was issued almost immediately.
Also this one is 120 days vs Finder's 90 days. You may end up waiting 150 days with a cashback, vs 90-95 days prepaid visa card.
[Woosta] hmmz i activated my optus prepaid sim about 40days ago..does that mean im not a new customer?
[caneshuga] Any way of scheduling transfer date when changing provider? I couldn’t see an option
[aiymen] Does it exclude BYO plans as ShopBack does?
[gimme] Does anyone know when the TCB offer ends?
